mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the lungs to circulation brought the earlier constructions together and showed how oxygen reaches distant tissues.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the airways after the lining was less clear: the picture made the capillary mesh look ready to add, but the game required the airways first.

surprise.text: I was surprised that the capillary mesh could not be added to the lined sacs until the airways were connected.

arbitrary.text: The required order of airways before capillaries felt somewhat arbitrary because both appeared to fit the stated goal.

continue.text: I would continue into another chapter: the connections between breathing, circulation and cellular work are interesting, and the picture descriptions helped explain them. Actual visual clarity remains untested.
